summary:
Frontend-only iteration 6 testing (no backend). Verified (1) Source Serif 4 applied to all H1/H2 on all 9 routes with body

and nav links remaining system font, (2) both pull quotes on /assetti-societari and /processi with exact text, italic Source Serif 4, 32px, rgb(30,58,107), 96px vertical margins, no quotation marks/pseudo-elements, (3) Home 'Le tre aree' 3-column grid on desktop/tablet with rgba(30,58,107,0.15) 1px vertical dividers and stacked single column on mobile 390px. Full regression re-run: 6 nav routes, 3 inline deep-links, criterio TOC (buttons) with smooth scroll + active state, numbered watermarks, /percorso timeline stages, tint bands, footer, per-page document.title, and zero horizontal overflow at 1920/1024/390. Zero console errors. Content integrity script confirms no prose changes vs HEAD.

issues: Column inner text widths are uneven (208px / 175px / 207px) because md:px-8 is applied to all columns while first:pl-0 / last:pr-0 remove only outer padding; the middle column loses 32px on both sides. Purely cosmetic - consider md:pr-8 / md:px-8 / md:pl-8 pattern for equal measures.
H2s render in gray-900 (near black) not navy - matches previous iterations' styling so treated as intentional (only font-family was to change), flagged for confirmation.

critical_code_review_comments: Editorial.jsx PullQuote hard-codes sizes 1.75rem/2rem - matches spec (28/32px), fine.
Home 'Le tre aree' column padding asymmetry (md:px-8 md:first:pl-0 md:last:pr-0) yields unequal text measure across the three columns; low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 design changes of iteration 6 verified end-to-end plus full regression; only a cosmetic column-padding asymmetry on Home remains open. Source Serif 4 is confirmed loaded (document.fonts.check('600 32px "Source Serif 4"') === true) - allow ~1s after navigation before asserting computed fonts.
